title: Larkspur Appraisal Order Fee Tariff by Report Type
content:
**Larkspur Home Lending — Appraisal Order fee tariff (US dollars).**

| Report type | Appraisal fee | Rush turn time offered | Rush fee | Trip fee | Reinspection fee | Rent schedule fee | Transfer review fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) | 375.00 | No | 0.00 | 0.00 | 150.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Exterior-Only Appraisal (Form 2055) | 450.00 | Yes | 100.00 | 75.00 | 150.00 | 125.00 | 95.00 |
| Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) | 625.00 | Yes | 150.00 | 125.00 | 175.00 | 150.00 | 95.00 |
| Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) | 650.00 | Yes | 150.00 | 125.00 | 175.00 | 150.00 | 95.00 |
| Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA) | 700.00 | Yes | 150.00 | 125.00 | 200.00 | 150.00 | 95.00 |
| Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) | 895.00 | Yes | 200.00 | 150.00 | 225.00 | 0.00 | 95.00 |
| Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) | 1150.00 | Yes | 250.00 | 175.00 | 250.00 | 150.00 | 125.00 |

### What each column is

1. **Appraisal fee** — the fee for the report of that type.
2. **Rush turn time offered** — whether rush turn time can be bought for that report type.
3. **Rush fee** — the fee for rush turn time; it reads 0.00 where rush is not offered.
4. **Trip fee** — the fee for an inspection appointment the appraiser kept but could not complete because of access the borrower controls; it reads 0.00 for the desktop report, which involves no visit.
5. **Reinspection fee** — the fee for a final inspection, that is a Form 1004D completion or update.
6. **Rent schedule fee** — the add-on fee for a comparable rent schedule (Form 1007) or an operating income statement (Form 216) when rental income is used; it reads 0.00 where that schedule is included in the report.
7. **Transfer review fee** — the fee to review a report transferred in from another lender; it reads 0.00 where transfers are not allowed for the report type.

### Notes on the tariff

- The Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) is the only report type with no rush offer, no trip fee and no transfer review fee.
- The Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) carries no rent schedule fee: the schedule is included in that report.
- A figure in this tariff is the amount for one charge of that kind on one order of that report type.
